q: How many odd days does an ordinary year have?
exp: Ordinary year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 odd day. Answer: 1

q: How many odd days does a leap year have?
exp: Leap year = 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 odd days. Answer: 2

q: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be after 61 days?
exp: 61 mod 7 = 5; Monday + 5 days = Saturday. Answer: Saturday

q: If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 100 days?
What was the day of the week on 1 January 2000?
exp: 1 January 2000 was a Saturday. Answer: Saturday

q: If 1 January is Monday, what day is 31 December of the same ordinary year?
exp: Ordinary year has 1 odd day; 31 Dec = 1 Jan + 1 day = Tuesday. Answer: Tuesday

q: How many leap years are there between 2001 and 2100 (inclusive of endpoints if leap)?
exp: Leap years 2004, 2008, ..., 2096; 2100 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 not 400); count = 24. Answer: 24

q: How many odd days are there in 100 years?
exp: 100 years = 24 leap + 76 ordinary; odd days = 24×2 + 76 = 124; 124 mod 7 = 5. Answer: 5

q: How many times does 29 February occur in 400 years?
exp: In 400 years there are 97 leap years (centuries not divisible by 400 are excluded); so 97 times. Answer: 97

q: What was the day of the week on 15 August 2021?
exp: 1 Jan 2021 = Friday; days to 15 Aug = 212 + 14 = 226; 226 mod 7 = 2; Friday + 2 = Sunday. Answer: Sunday

q: The calendar for the year 2024 will be the same as the calendar for which year?
exp: Leap year calendars repeat every 28 years; 2024 - 28 = 1996. Answer: 1996

q: If 31 December is a Sunday, what day of the week was 1 January of that ordinary year?
exp: In an ordinary year, 31 Dec = 1 Jan + 1 day; so 1 Jan = Sunday - 1 = Saturday. Answer: Saturday

q: What was the day of the week on 15 October 2023?
exp: 1 Jan 2023 = Sunday; days to 15 Oct = 273 + 14 = 287; 287 mod 7 = 0; Sunday + 0 = Sunday. Answer: Sunday
